notes: Governing document: the Faculty Parental Leave policy (2018_01, dated October 2000; capture 2017-01-27, which its version note says is in force on 2018-02-24). The faculty are not unionised per the version note. Faculty Manual 2.37 and 2.55, the FMLA policy and the Disability Benefits policy are governing policies; the 2017-12-07 SU News article is a summary.

Calendar: the documents name fall and spring semesters ('fall semester leaves to begin the following September', 'spring semester leaves'); kind of term stated without length → calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Parental leave options (c3, c4) are linked in_lieu_of each other (R3c) and in_lieu_of the combined semester release (c6), which the policy gives a birth parent whose childbirth disability extends at least 4 weeks into the semester in place of the separate parental-leave options; the maternity leave (c5) is within c6 (R3b) and carries no in_lieu_of (R15b).

Birth parent chain: maternity leave c5 (6-8 weeks, full pay) within the semester teaching release c6 [alternative: c5 then parental leave c4 (up to half a semester without duties) or c3 (50% workload reduction for a semester), also_available, longest-leave order]; Salary Continuation Plan c7 (16 weeks full pay) concurrent with c5, then c8 (10 weeks at 60%); NY disability benefits c10 concurrent with c7 from week 2; FMLA c11 alongside from the start of c5 (S1), with accrued sick/vacation c12 within FMLA.

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave c4 (up to half a semester without formal duties) or c3 (50% workload reduction in a semester), in lieu of each other, if the primary caregiver; FMLA c11 alongside c4 from its start (S1). c6 and c5 are birth-parent only.
The Faculty Parental Leave policy requires primary-caregiver status for parental leave and the combination; the derivation treats caregiver conditions as gender-neutral (R6).

Not components: the research leave in Faculty Manual 2.55 (one semester at full pay or an academic year at half pay) exists to encourage scholarly research and cannot be taken for a birth; FMLA military family leave; workers' compensation.

Faculty Manual 2.55's future-service clause ('research leave, or another type of leave, with pay') is recorded on the administrative leave (c13); the text does not say whether it applies to the parental leave policy.

SU News 2017-12-07 (2018_07): New York Paid Family Leave applies to staff and student employees, not to those working in a teaching capacity; faculty 'continue to be eligible for leaves of absence and paid parental leave benefits, and may request administrative leave'. PFL coded as c14/c15 with the staff group, excludes_main_faculty and summary_only.

Documents cited but not saved: the Salary Continuation Plan document and 'Disability Benefits and the Salary Continuation Plan'; 'Syracuse University Non-Exempt Disability Benefits'; Faculty Parental Leave Form; Faculty Leave Deadlines and Procedures; Parental and Maternity Leave Checklist for Deans and Chairs; FMLA Notice Posting; the Faculty Manual provision letting faculty exercising FMLA rights exceed the tenure-extension limit; the SU Policies pages linked from Faculty Manual 2.54 (Benefits Eligibility, Disability Plan, Leave of Absence); faculty sick-time and vacation policies (accrued sick time); the HR website PFL FAQ; N.Y. WCL s. 205 (DBL duration) and s. 203-b (PFL job protection).
